question: Which political leader won the by-poll election from Champawat constituency in Uttarakhand, in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushkar Singh Dhami **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct answer **is option 2, **Pushkar Singh Dhami**, who won the by-**poll election **from **Champawat constituency** in **Uttarakhand** in **May 2022.**
 
• Pushkar Singh Dhami is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) and was appointed as the** Chief Minister of Uttarakhand** in** July 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jagat Prakash Nadda** is the **current President of the BJP** and has been actively involved in the party's election campaigns and political strategies.
 
• **Piyush Goyal** is a **Union Minister **in the Government of India and has held various portfolios such as Railways, Commerce and Industry, and Power and Renewable Energy.
 
• **Narendra Modi** is the **Prime Minister of India **and the leader of the BJP. He has been instrumental in shaping the party's policies and vision for the country.
 
• Hence, the statement "Which political leader won the by-poll election from Champawat constituency in Uttarakhand, in May 2022?" is** correct **and the answer is option 2, Pushkar Singh Dhami.
